skill.name: chapter-outline-generator
skill.description: Generates detailed chapter outlines for books with key scenes, plot progression, character arcs, themes, and transitions.
skill.summary: Creates structured chapter-by-chapter outlines for fiction and narrative book planning.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious code or risky patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review of SKILL.md found ordinary story-planning instructions and no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or tool abuse intent.

content.value_statement: Planning a book can stall when chapters lack clear purpose. This skill turns story details into structured chapter outlines with arcs, scenes, themes, and transitions.
actual_capabilities: Asks for missing story details such as title, genre, plot summary, and chapter count.
Organizes chapters around a standard narrative arc from setup to resolution.
Creates chapter entries with titles, key events, conflicts, and emotional tone.
Adds character development moments, themes, subplots, foreshadowing, and lore notes.
Uses Markdown lists with clear sub-points for each chapter.
Checks the sequence for logical flow and continuity.
limitations: It creates outlines, not full manuscript chapters.
It depends on the story details supplied by the user.
It does not verify historical, scientific, or legal accuracy for story content.
It cannot guarantee originality beyond the user's premise and instructions.

use_cases.title: Plan a First Draft
use_cases.description: Turn a premise into a chapter-by-chapter roadmap before writing scenes.

use_cases.title: Expand a Story Idea
use_cases.description: Develop a loose concept into a structured plot with rising action and resolution.

use_cases.title: Check Story Continuity
use_cases.description: Review an existing outline for missing transitions, weak arcs, and contradictions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Chapter Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a simple book structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a chapter outline for my book. Title: [title]. Genre: [genre]. Plot summary: [summary]. Chapters: [number].

prompt_templates.title: Character Arc Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Writer who wants stronger character development.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a chapter outline that shows the protagonist's emotional arc. Include key conflicts, turning points, themes, and chapter transitions.

prompt_templates.title: Subplot and Foreshadowing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed chapter outline with main plot, subplots, foreshadowing, lore details, emotional tone, and cliffhangers.

prompt_templates.title: Continuity Revision
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my outline for continuity, pacing, unresolved arcs, and contradictions. Then suggest revised chapter beats with clear transitions.

output_examples.input: A 12-chapter fantasy novel about an apprentice cartographer who discovers a living map.
output: Chapter entries include titles, setup, inciting incident, rising action, midpoint, climax, and resolution.
Each chapter lists conflicts, character changes, themes, lore clues, and a transition to the next chapter.

output_examples.input: A memoir outline about rebuilding a family business after a crisis.
output: The outline separates personal stakes, business setbacks, relationship changes, and recovery milestones.
Chapters progress from setup through crisis, rebuilding, reflection, and final resolution.

best_practices: Provide genre, target chapter count, main characters, and the central conflict.
State the desired tone and themes before requesting the outline.
Ask for a continuity pass after major plot changes.
anti_patterns: Requesting an outline with only a title and no plot context.
Changing the genre or ending after the outline is complete without asking for revision.
Using the outline as final prose without adding scenes, voice, and detail.

faq.question: Can this skill write full chapters?
faq.answer: It is designed for outlines, not complete chapter drafts. It can help plan scenes before drafting.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the title, genre, main plot summary, chapter count, main characters, and any required themes.

faq.question: Does it support nonfiction books?
faq.answer: It works best for narrative books, but it can structure memoirs and narrative nonfiction with clear arcs.

faq.question: Can it revise an existing outline?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the outline and ask for continuity, pacing, subplot, or character arc improvements.

faq.question: Does it create Markdown output?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks the assistant to use a Markdown list with clear sub-points for each chapter.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to use with private story ideas?
faq.answer: The skill is prompt-only and contains no code. Users should still avoid sharing sensitive personal details.
